twitter_thread:
Marketing teams aren't too small. They're under-automated.

Here are the 5 workflows where AI delivers the fastest ROI for marketing — with exact trigger-action sequences: 🧵

Workflow 1: Content Production Pipeline

Brief approved → AI drafts → SEO audit runs → editor reviews → CMS formatted → published → performance data feeds next brief

The feedback loop is the key. Most pipelines are linear. This one compounds.

Workflow 2: Campaign Performance Monitoring

Every 4 hours → pull Google Ads + Meta data → compare to 7-day baseline → flag CPA spike >30% or CTR drop >20% → Slack alert with context

The window between 'something's off' and '$10k wasted' is a few hours. Close it.

Workflow 3: Social Content Calendar

Editorial calendar approved → AI drafts all posts per platform format → brand voice check → posted to Buffer for review → approved posts scheduled

30-minute review pass instead of 3 hours of production.

Workflow 4: Email Sequence Automation

Lead enters CRM with segment tag → AI generates personalized copy per step → scheduled at optimal send times → engagement data feeds back into optimization

Personalization at scale. No manual segmentation.

Workflow 5: Competitor Monitoring Digest

Friday 4pm → competitor blogs checked → G2 reviews pulled → pricing page changes flagged → weekly digest posted to Slack

Every team knows they should do this. Almost none do it consistently. Automation fixes that.

The first one to automate: the weekly analytics report.

3–4 hours of skilled time. Zero creative judgment. Immediate visible value to leadership.

Connect GA4 + HubSpot → WorkflowFiesta → Slack. Done.
